messages.subject: Custom output bindings with javascript
parts:
I'm trying to implement a custom binding with javascript, but I can't get the chart to render. Admittedly, I don't know much javascript so I tried to replicate the example from here https://github.com/jcheng5/shiny-js-examples/tree/master/output with a different javascript library (c3.js). I can't get the chart to render. My code is here: https://github.com/xerlivex/c3-js-app What am I doing wrong?

Some one tried to do the same thing a while ago, but got no help http://stackoverflow.com/questions/33429253/shiny-custom-output-binding

messages.subject: Re: Custom output bindings with javascript
parts:
Looking at your example, it seems you'd like to use NVD3.

Could you use NVD3 from the rCharts package? You wouldn't need to worry about the custom bindings then.

https://github.com/ramnathv/rCharts
